artifact.smart_checklist_markdown:
# CRT-638 — Smart Checklist (draft)

## Instrument suggestion — FX_SPOT on Corner Trader (dxTrade5 / WebBroker)
- Primary focus: Surface FX_SPOT in dxTrade5/WebTrader instrument suggestion: All tab includes FX spot instruments; FX Spot tab shows only FX_SPOT; column filters expose Forex type and FX_Spot for instrument/symbol/instrument-type filters. **Adaptive** not in scope (CRT-632). Labels: Type **FX Spot**; **Exchange** empty for spot rows per CRT-1875 / FOREX note on CT page 342174235.

### All tab
- [CRT-1745] **dxTrade5** — In each instrument suggestion widget with search, **All** tab lists FX_SPOT instruments together with other allowed types when user types a symbol query.
- [CRT-1745] **WebBroker** — Same **All** tab behaviour where dxTrade5 widgets are embedded in WebBroker per platform configuration.
> Design: https://www.figma.com/design/DNmyG15cyGltqx7x5GY9C1/CornerBank-WebTrader-Dark?node-id=15389-94878&t=G2bA6rhQxQ6A2mYs-0
> Widgets called out in validation practice: Order Entry, Time and Sales, Watchlist, Alerts, Derivatives, Risk Profile (scope to those with instrument search).
- [CRT-1745] Search matches by **Symbol**, **Description**, partial string; matching substrings highlighted per platform UX.
- [CRT-1745] Search is **case-insensitive** (lower / upper / mixed) and tolerates **whitespace** in description (e.g. partial "Euro vs").
- [CRT-1745] Result columns include **Symbol**, **Description**, **Type** showing **FX Spot** for FX_SPOT rows.
- [CRT-1875] **Exchange** column for FOREX / FX_SPOT rows in suggestion results is **empty** (per requirement block bundled under FX Spot section on CT page 342174235).
- [CRT-1745] Row data for symbol and description is **consistent with IPF** (no stale or duplicate rows for same instrument).

### FX Spot tab
- [CRT-1744] Tab labelled **FX Spot** exists and is selectable wherever instrument suggestion tabs are shown (dxTrade5 / embedded WebBroker).
- [CRT-1744] **FX Spot** tab lists **only** FX_SPOT instruments (no CFD_FOREX-only rows, no conversion-rate FOREX rows).
- [CRT-1744] With **no search text**, placeholder / empty-search behaviour matches spec (e.g. "Start typing to find instruments…") and still restricts tab content to FX_SPOT family.
- [CRT-1744] Search behaviour (symbol, description, partial, case, whitespace) mirrors **All** tab expectations **within** FX Spot tab.
- [CRT-1875] Columns **Symbol**, **Description**, **Exchange** empty for spot rows; **Type** / labels show **FX Spot** where applicable.
- [CRT-1744] When no FX_SPOT matches query, user sees **no-match** messaging (e.g. "No symbol matches your search criteria…").
- [CRT-1744] Instruments shown under **All** vs **FX Spot** for the same query are **consistent** (same instrument metadata where both lists include it).

### Account permissions
- [CRT-1745] FX_SPOT remains visible/selectable per **account trading permissions** where instrument suggestion respects allowed instruments (full trading, close-only, no trading, subtype not allowed) — expected gating matches account configuration.

## Column filters (instrument / symbol / instrument type)
### Instrument column
- [CRT-1745] **dxTrade5** widgets with column filters: Account Transactions, Orders, Positions, Trades, Trading Journal — filter by instrument finds FX_SPOT instruments; **FX Spot** type label shown in results.
- [CRT-1745] **WebBroker**: Order Book, Position Book, Transactions — same filter behaviour for FX_SPOT.
> Filter by full symbol and partial string; **Found** list shows expected rows only.

### Symbol column
- [CRT-1745] **dxTrade5** and **WebBroker** symbol column filters (same widget set as above) resolve FX_SPOT instruments and show **FX Spot** type label.

### Instrument type column
- [CRT-1744] **Instrument Type** filter offers **FX Spot** (or equivalent label) in dropdown on Orders, Positions, Trades, Trading Journal (dxTrade5) and Order Book, Position Book, Transactions (WebBroker).
- [CRT-1744] **FX Spot** entry is in correct **alphabetical** position in the type list.
- [CRT-1744] Selecting **FX Spot** alone filters grid to **only** FX_SPOT instruments.
- [CRT-1744] Multi-select **FX Spot** + other types returns **union** of rows with correct per-row type labels.

## Jira validation notes (retest targets)
- [CRT-638] Epic validation v403: verify fixes for **XT-7667** (instrument suggest exchange column cut-off), **XT-7668** (FX Spot tab label casing), **XT-7530** (instrument type column naming for FX_SPOT).
> Retest when build contains fixes; link defects in test report.
